summary: Fees confirmed ($50 W/E base, $60 full hookup) on the 2026 rate page and on Firefly for May, July and October 2027 weeknights; added 7-night and holiday rates. Added 50-amp/water/sewer, pull-throughs, bath house/laundry/store/dump, season May-October, Firefly booking link, check-in/out times. Cleared the note-derived 50-ft max. Note rewritten: dropped the field facts and the unsupported '(RV sites not creekside)'. Gate: exactly $50 - at the line, not over.
flags: Private gate facts: cheapest real RV night $50.00 (Water & Electric, 2 adults + 2 children) on the 2026 rate page and on Firefly for a 23-ft Class C on weeknights in May, July and October 2027 - the same in every season, no cheaper night found; $50 is at the line, not over it. Google Maps 4.7 stars from 188 reviews (listed as 'Foxfire Family Fun Park'), phone (740) 482-2190 matches; not in the Good Sam directory; nearest gateway none within 40 km (Columbus 98 km); presence: operator website with phone plus a live Firefly engine. Passes.

Long-stay character: most of the map is Seasonal W/E and Seasonal Full-Hookup sites and there is a seasonal waiting list, but about 60 overnight sites are sold by the night on Firefly at a posted rate - tests 2 and 4 pass.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront): the operator markets 'grassy campsites with the view of Brokensword Creek' / 'Creekside View Campsites', and Firefly tags overnight W/E sites 200-208 'creek site'. On the operator's map those sites sit on the outer edge of the east loop with a tree band between them and the creek. The old note's '(RV sites not creekside)' was a Claude call with no cited source, so I dropped it; the creekside/creek-view call needs the imagery gate.
Pin about 250 m off: it sits on the road at the office/entrance; the site loops centre near 40.8360,-83.1097 on imagery (estimate from the satellite tile, no per-site coordinates published).
